assertions.title: Drawer — open/close, focus trap, ESC, idempotent close

steps.expected: All Drawer tests pass with -race
steps.observed: 2 snapshot tests + 23 unit tests PASS. Tests cover: open (content rendered, title visible), closed renders nothing, close via ESC, ESC ignored when closed, focus trap Tab, focus trap Shift-Tab, keys ignored when not focused, focus restore on close, focus restore not called when already closed, double-close safe, double-close via ESC safe, scroll content, page down/up, home/end, focus indicator when open, no focus indicator when unfocused, Open method, Open method idempotent, SetContent, close hint rendered, empty content, scroll clamped.

steps.action: Inspect drawer.go for focus trap logic
steps.expected: Tab/Shift-Tab consumed within drawer; do not escape
steps.observed: HandleKey() checks `if !d.open || !d.focused { return false }`. When open+focused, Tab returns true (consumed) without propagating. ESC triggers Close(). Keys don't escape.

steps.action: Inspect ESC handler and close callback
steps.expected: ESC closes drawer; OnClose fires exactly once per cycle
steps.observed: HandleKey ESC → d.Close(). Close() checks `if !d.open { return }` then `if !d.closeFired { d.closeFired = true; d.onClose() }`. The closeFired flag ensures exactly-once semantics.

steps.expected: On close, focus restored to previously-focused element
steps.observed: Close() calls `d.onRestoreFocus(d.previouslyFocused)` when both are set. TestDrawerFocusRestoreOnClose verifies 'entity-list' ref is passed to callback.

steps.expected: Double-close is safe (no panic, no double-fire)
steps.observed: TestDrawerDoubleCloseSafe: Close() twice → closeCount=1 (not 2). TestDrawerDoubleCloseViaESCSafe: ESC twice → closeCount=1, second ESC not consumed. Both pass.

steps.expected: ≥1 tuistory snapshot of open state
steps.observed: 2 MockTerminal snapshot tests: TestSnapshotDrawerOpen (drawer-open.txt) and TestSnapshotDrawerOpenScrolled (drawer-open-scrolled.txt). TestDrawerFocusedVsUnfocusedBorder verifies border color differs between focused/unfocused states.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. VAL-CMP-004 (EntityList): 22+ unit tests cover navigation (up/down/home/end/page), wrap-around, focus indicator (colored left border '▌' with BorderFocus color, not font-weight only), empty/loading/error states, and selection background. 3 MockTerminal + 3 tuistory snapshots. VAL-CMP-005 (DetailPane): 24 tests cover header+status badge, title truncation with '…' ellipsis, section separators (─), scrollable body with scrollbar thumb (┃), empty state guidance, and focus indicator. 4 snapshot tests. VAL-CMP-006 (Tabs): 31 tests cover forward/back navigation (arrows+h/l+Tab/Shift-Tab), wrap-around, colored underline (━ Accent) active indicator beyond font-weight, focused vs unfocused distinguishable. 3 snapshot tests. VAL-CMP-007 (Drawer): 25 tests cover open/close, focus trap (Tab/Shift-Tab consumed), ESC close with exactly-once OnClose callback, previously-focused element restoration, double-close safety. 2 snapshot tests. All tests run with -race flag, no race conditions detected.
